title: An ivory mounted boxwood Clarinet by GOULDING & Co London, circa 1820. With five brass keys, square flaps on wood blocks, with mouthpiece and cover, overall length 25 1/4in. (650mm). A RARE EARLY BASS RECORDER ATTRIBUTED TO DUPUIS IN PARIS, CIRCA 1690. Of ebony with heavy ivory collars and mounts, inset with stained green and black coloured ivory spot decoration.
